name: Лавка Энериума — витрина доната (слово автора 30.09.2026: «5 стартовых наборов, все с х2 и 5 градаций… наборы малого, среднего, большого, огромного и великого энериума, подписки дающие энериум раз в день, всего 3 штуки, боевой пропуск, лимитированные предложения»; правило автора для донатных окон — «дорого-богато»). Три листа вещей на чёрном ключе (нарезка — craft_layers.py sheet) и зал-фон. Стартовые наборы — пять связок нарастающего богатства: рунные ключи (тёмное железо, ушко — колесо со спицами, как значок rune-key), души (бледно-голубое пламя в стекле, как значок souls) и Энериум (зелёные кристаллы времени, #4FDC8B). Наборы Энериума — горсть, мешочек, шкатулка, сундук, друза. Выдача — три чаши раз в день. Предложения — «Дар пути», «Лавка недели», «Праздничный дар». Печать платного ряда пропуска «Осенний путь», знак рекламы. Выгрузка — tools/art-gen/ui-art.json → design/ui/assets/art/store/, пути — EN_STORE.art (tools/content-gen/store/build.js).
style: Art style: dark fantasy game art for a premium mobile RPG — rich, regal, ancient and precious. Hand-painted digital painting: visible confident brush strokes, simplified planes, deep near-black shadows, crisp rim light on edges, rich material detail and masterful craftsmanship. Materials: old gold that gleams softly, dark bronze, black marble veined with gold, dark oak, deep green velvet, blackened iron. Light is precious and comes from below and from within: the cold green glow of time-crystals (#4FDC8B) and the pale blue glow of soul flames (#8FDCFF), with a few warm amber highlights (#E6A84B). Everything looks heavy, made by a master and worth a fortune: no cheap shine, no plastic, no clean saturated game-UI colors. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime, no cartoon, no flat vector style.
negative: No words, no letters, no digits, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no Roman numerals, no runes, glyphs or markings that look like writing, no labels, no price tags, no handwriting, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no buttons, no border or frame around the whole picture. No coins. No skulls, no skeletons, no blood, no gore. No pentagrams, no occult signs, no crosses, no religious symbols, no eyes, no faces. No people, no hands, no creatures. No candles with dripping wax. No purple or violet light, no neon. No bright polished gold, no glossy plastic shine, no clean bright mobile-game UI look.
cutout_rule: The background is one solid flat color {hex}, perfectly even from edge to edge: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no wall, no table under the object, no cast shadow, no vignette, no checkerboard. The object itself never uses this background color. Any glow stays close to the object and fades out within a short distance.

st-sheet.frame:
Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply.

Format: a game UI sheet for a dark fantasy mobile RPG — six separate objects laid out in a strict grid of three columns and two rows, every object centered in its own equal cell and filling about two thirds of it, all seen from the front and slightly above, in a gentle three-quarter view. Between the objects and around them the canvas is solid pure black, with wide equal empty black gaps: no object touches another object or the edge of the canvas. Nothing connects the objects: no lines, no shared background, no shadows. Each cell holds exactly one object — the details of that object belong to it and never spill into a neighbouring cell.

st-hall.frame:
Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply.

Format: a wide cinematic background, 21:9, painted edge to edge over the whole frame — no black bars at the top or bottom, no letterbox, no dark border. It is the full-screen background of the shop window of a mobile game; the interface lays rows of cards over most of it. Seen straight on at the height of a standing person, a calm symmetric composition with depth, the vanishing point in the center. The wide middle band, from 20% to 85% of the height, stays calm, dim, soft and low in contrast; the richest detail and the brightest light gather along the upper edge, the left and right edges and along the bottom. No figures of any kind. The attached pictures show the painting style, the brushwork and the light of the game — take only the style from them, not the place.

jobs.title: Стартовые наборы I–V и печать платного ряда — лист 3 × 2
jobs.source: Пять стартовых наборов цепочкой, все ×2, градации по количеству ресурсов (слово автора 30.09.2026): «Котомка странника», «Дорожный ларец», «Окованный ларец», «Реликварий», «Сокровищница» — tools/content-gen/store/build.js, CHAIN. Решение агента: связка растёт в богатстве слева направо и сверху вниз, в каждой — рунные ключи, души в стекле и кристаллы Энериума. Шестая клетка — печать платного ряда пропуска «Осенний путь». К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/store/start-1…5.png, pass-seal.png (craft_layers.py sheet).
jobs.subject: The sheet: SIX treasures that grow richer from the first to the fifth. Three kinds of treasure repeat in them: dark iron keys whose bow is a small spoked wheel, pale blue soul flames held in small glass vessels, and green glowing crystals of time. Top row, from left to right: (1) a small worn leather travel satchel with its flap thrown open — one dark iron key with a spoked-wheel bow hangs from its strap, two small green glowing crystals peek out of it, and a tiny stoppered glass vial with a pale blue flame is tucked under its buckle; (2) a small travel casket of dark oak with dark bronze corners, its lid open — inside on deep green velvet lie two dark iron keys with spoked-wheel bows, a small glass lantern with a pale blue flame and a handful of green glowing crystals; (3) a sturdy chest of dark oak bound with blackened iron and old-gold rivets, its lid open and filled with green glowing crystals — a ring of three dark iron keys hangs from its lock, and two small glass vials of pale blue flame stand at its front corners. Bottom row, from left to right: (4) an ornate reliquary casket of black marble and old-gold filigree, its lid raised — inside a heap of large green glowing crystals, a ring of dark iron keys laid across its front, and a small old-gold lantern with a bright pale blue soul flame standing on its lid; (5) the grandest treasure of the sheet: a great chest of black marble and old gold on four clawed feet, overflowing with large green glowing crystals that spill over its rim, a tall cluster of green crystals rising from its middle, a heavy ring of many dark iron keys hanging from its front, and two old-gold lanterns with bright pale blue soul flames at its sides; (6) a heavy round seal medallion of old gold with a raised relief of a single maple leaf in its middle and one small green crystal set above the leaf, a short ribbon of deep green silk hanging below it.

jobs.title: Наборы Энериума — малый, средний, большой, огромный, великий — и знак рекламы, лист 3 × 2
jobs.source: Слово автора 30.09.2026: «наборы малого, среднего, большого, огромного и великого энериума» — tools/content-gen/store/build.js, PACKS. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/store/pack-1…5.png, ad.png (craft_layers.py sheet).
jobs.subject: The sheet: SIX objects; the first five hold more and more green glowing crystals of time. Top row, from left to right: (1) a small scatter of three green glowing crystals lying on a folded scrap of deep green velvet; (2) a small drawstring pouch of deep green velvet stitched with old-gold thread, open and spilling about a dozen green glowing crystals; (3) a small open casket of dark oak with bronze corners, filled to the brim with green glowing crystals. Bottom row, from left to right: (4) a large open chest of dark oak bound in old gold, heaped high with green glowing crystals that spill over its rim; (5) the grandest object of the sheet: a great cluster of large green glowing crystals rising from a round pedestal of black marble and old gold, the tallest crystal as tall as the whole cluster, green light streaming upward from it; (6) a small hourglass of old gold and dark bronze whose falling sand glows green, one small green crystal resting beside its base.

jobs.subject: The sheet: SIX objects. Top row, from left to right — three chalices that are filled with green light once a day, each richer than the last: (1) a small plain chalice of dark bronze holding a few green glowing crystals, a single drop of green light falling into it from above; (2) a tall goblet of old gold with a band of dark bronze, brimming with green light and green crystals, two drops of green light falling into it; (3) the richest of the three: a grand chalice of black marble and old gold on a heavy stepped foot, overflowing with green light and crystals, a thin stream of green light pouring down into it from above. Bottom row, from left to right: (4) a small free-standing stone archway with an old-gold keystone, its opening filled with soft green light, a few steps leading into it; (5) a bundle wrapped in dark cloth, tied crosswise with a deep green silk ribbon and sealed with old-gold wax, one green crystal tucked under the ribbon; (6) a round festive lantern of old-gold filigree hanging from a short chain, warm amber light inside it and small green crystals hanging from its rim like icicles.

jobs.title: Зал Лавки Энериума — сокровищница, фон витрины
jobs.source: Правило автора для донатных окон — «дорого-богато». Решение агента: сокровищница в башне — своды чёрного мрамора с золотом, по бокам — ниши с окованными ларцами и кристаллами времени, из пола растут зелёные кристаллы; середина спокойная — под ряды карточек. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/store/hall.jpg, 1688×716.
jobs.subject: Subject: a treasury vault deep inside an ancient tower — the hall of a shop where the crystals of time are kept. Tall arches of black marble inlaid with old gold recede into darkness on both sides; in deep niches along the side walls stand closed brass-bound coffers and small heaps of green glowing crystals. Clusters of green crystals of time grow from the floor at the left and right edges and throw green light upward onto the arches. Across the bottom of the picture runs a broad low step of polished black marble veined with gold, with a thin line of green light along its edge. High above, a few hanging lamps of old gold give warm amber light. Fine golden dust drifts slowly in the air. Rich, regal and quiet — a place where something precious waits.
